label: Port_Scanning
title: Port scanning (network service discovery)
description: An attacker probes a target's network ports to learn which services are listening and which may be vulnerable. The probing usually shows up as many connection attempts to many ports from one source, often with no completed sessions. Scanning is typically a preparation step before exploitation.
mitigation: Block unused ports and services, rate-limit connection attempts per source, and alert on one source touching many ports in a short window.
mitigation_basis: general practice, not yet checked against the cited source
source_name: MITRE ATT&CK T1046 Network Service Discovery
